units.source_text: 真是个绝妙的隐蔽场所……

en.t: It was truly an ideal hiding place...

units.source_text: 沙之纹理像贝壳内部般光滑，到处都没有人走过的痕迹……

en.t: The texture of the sand was as smooth as the inside of a shell, and there was no trace anywhere of anyone having walked there...

units.source_text: 但，你这家伙自己的脚印怎么样了？……

en.t: But what about your own footprints?...

units.source_text: 回过头一看，三十米开外的脚印，已经完全被抹掉了……

en.t: When he looked back, the footprints thirty meters away had already been completely erased...

units.source_text: 就是脚跟前，也眼看着崩塌变形……

en.t: Even right in front of his feet, they were visibly collapsing and changing shape...

units.source_text: 遇到大风的日子，看来也并不见得全是坏事。

en.t: It seemed that days with strong winds were not necessarily all bad after all.
